Bio-Regeneration Science
How Does It Work?

Polynucleotide Technology

Purified polynucleotide DNA fragments stimulate fibroblast activity at the cellular level. They act as a bio-scaffold that triggers natural collagen and elastin production, repairs damaged cells, and improves skin hydration from within â delivering true regeneration, not just cosmetic improvement.

Multi-Point Injection

Ultra-fine needles deliver the polynucleotide solution via precise micro-injections at multiple points across the treatment area. This ensures even distribution and maximum bio-availability. The treatment stimulates natural skin healing processes for long-lasting, natural-looking results.

Your Questions Answered
Frequently Asked Questions

Does Poly Peptide hurt?

With numbing cream applied 20 minutes before, the procedure is very comfortable. Most clients feel only mild pinching during injections. The entire session takes 30 minutes total.

How soon will I see results?

Some patients feel improvements immediately after the first session â increased muscle firmness and toning. Visible fat reduction typically appears 2â4 weeks after completing all 4 sessions, with optimal results at 2â3 months as fat cells are naturally eliminated.

How long do results last?

Results typically last 6â12 months from a series of 3 treatments. Maintenance sessions every 6 months preserve the benefits long-term. Consistent good skincare extends results.

Can I combine it with other treatments?

Yes! Emsculpt NEO pairs excellently with treatments like CoolSculpting, Exilis Elite, and lymphatic drainage. Our experts at ISAAC Luxe can design a comprehensive body contouring plan tailored to your goals.

Can I combine it with other treatments?

Absolutely! Poly Peptides pair beautifully with Rejuran (for deeper scar repair), HydraFacial, AQUAGOLD, and Botox. Dr. Geetika creates customized protocols for comprehensive rejuvenation.

What's the difference from fillers?

Fillers add volume by sitting in the skin. Poly Peptides don't add volume â they regenerate your own skin's tissue, collagen, and hydration. Completely different mechanism, truly natural results.
